raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`ExaoneMoEForCausalLM` never set `model_runner.sliding_window_size`, so the triton backend built no window buffers and every sliding layer failed at kernel compile (`kv_indptr is None`). The window passed to `RadixAttention` was also one too large: HF counts the query token inside the window, SGLang counts only the earlier tokens (`exaone4.py` and `gemma3_causal.py` already subtract one).

Part 1 of the K-EXAONE 1.0 serving stack. (I'll continuously support EXAONE for SGLang) 

## Modifications

- Add a module-level `get_attention_sliding_window_size(config)` returning `config.sliding_window - 1` and use it for the `RadixAttention` window on sliding layers.
- Expose the same value through `ExaoneMoEForCausalLM.get_attention_sliding_window_size()` so the attention backends build their window buffers.

## Accuracy Tests

16x A100 40GB, bf16, TP16, `--attention-backend triton`: before this change the server fails at the first sliding layer; after it, generation is coherent at 400 tokens. With the follow-up MTP-head change (It will be part 2) MTP acceptance is 0.880 (gsm8k) / 0.737 (mt-bench), GSM8K 90.0 (1319, non-thinking).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable (correctness fix; no kernel or scheduling change).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (the window value is asserted by the unit test added in part 2)
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -69,6 +69,12 @@
 _is_cuda = is_cuda()
 
 
+def get_attention_sliding_window_size(config: PretrainedConfig) -> int:
+    # HF counts the query token inside the window; SGLang counts only the
+    # earlier tokens (see exaone4.py, gemma3_causal.py).
+    return config.sliding_window - 1
+
+
 class ExaoneMoEMLP(nn.Module):
     def __init__(
         self,
@@ -389,7 +395,9 @@ def __init__(
             layer_id=layer_id,
             prefix=add_prefix("attn", prefix),
             sliding_window_size=(
-                config.sliding_window if self.sliding_window else None
+                get_attention_sliding_window_size(config)
+                if self.sliding_window
+                else None
             ),
         )
         self.layer_id = layer_id
@@ -735,6 +743,9 @@ def start_layer(self):
     def end_layer(self):
         return self.model.end_layer
 
+    def get_attention_sliding_window_size(self) -> int:
+        return get_attention_sliding_window_size(self.config)
+
     def get_embed_and_head(self):
         return self.model.embed_tokens.weight, self.lm_head.weight
